energy_attribution.scope: simulation wiring only; no scientific energy result

budget.clock_origin: before input read; imports excluded for all methods
budget.execution_stop: cooperative checkpoints, not a hard real-time process stop
budget.evidence_cutoff: one absolute monotonic deadline; no round reset

startup.rule: sum exclusive segments only; overview is not an extra cost

execution_timing.rule: startup overview contains its components; final close is a separate actual interval
